scope: Final read-only review of the collector and existing identity/integrity contracts; not an independent external audit
verified_by_inspection: Fixed application GET routes; no arbitrary endpoint or broker transport is accepted
The observation snapshot is pinned once; account, snapshot_id, head, counts, offsets, linked records and hashes are verified
Ledger pages require one account, one ledger_integrity and contiguous total coverage; changed revision aborts without automatic restart
Health version and startedAt are compared at both ends; this is local instance consistency, not remote attestation
Complete collection requires existing snapshot and ledger semantic verifiers; it does not assign level4 or financial approval
Password is supplied through the environment; URL credentials and password CLI options are excluded; redirects and known credential echoes are rejected
Response size, category bytes, total bytes, page counts, request counts and timeout have hard maxima; no incomplete network response is persisted as an accepted source
Output directory acquisition is exclusive and retained failures cannot be mistaken for collection_receipt.json
GET observation snapshot creates bounded snapshot metadata in the runtime; the receipt explicitly discloses this small state mutation

explicit_scope_limitations.fixed_configuration_comparison: The funded comparison requires identical source configuration across the full exported prefix. A prefix containing a causal dynamic-universe rotation can pass source collection and causal-panel streaming verification while being rejected for this fixed-configuration comparison. This is an explicit scope restriction, not an instruction to delete, reset, rewrite or selectively prune journals.
explicit_scope_limitations.session_count: 100 distinct sessions are an implemented scalar-model input requirement, not sufficient evidence of profit or even a guarantee that rows, labels, models, account/cost bindings and comparison validation will pass.
explicit_scope_limitations.source_collection: COMPLETE_SOURCE_COLLECTION means complete transport and local integrity within the selected limits. economic_score remains null and economic_evidence_complete/financial_acceptance_allowed remain false.
explicit_scope_limitations.separate_snapshots: Observation and account snapshots are separately fixed. The existing downstream gate must bind the actual comparison period; equal account identity alone does not establish simultaneous snapshots.
explicit_scope_limitations.coverage_summary: The collector summarizes the ledger derived current-coverage fields. Eligibility of a covered historical prefix is assessed by level4_readiness against the chosen comparison period; the collector is not that assessment.
explicit_scope_limitations.bounded_time: Synchronous local verification may run until the event loop resumes. Deadlines are checked, but no hard real-time completion guarantee is established.
explicit_scope_limitations.authenticity: Hashes and endpoint authentication do not provide independent proof of original data/provider authenticity.
